column7:
Reduction in provision
by re-appropriation of
₹4.23 lakh was
attributed to anticipated
saving. Surrender of
₹0.01 lakh was
attributed to equivalent
grants from Bihar
Contingency Fund.
Final excess of ₹31.13
lakh is overstated by
₹49.17 lakh due to
clearance of OB
suspense related to
previous years.
Therefore, it is actual
saving of ₹18.04 lakh.
Reasons for actual
saving have not been
intimated (July 2024).
